thread:
maria: Heads-up — EdgeHalo reported a billing delta after yesterday's rollout. Their ingestor is sending minute-level usage but our marketplace adapter is rolling it up hourly, causing mismatched entitlements and duplicate credits.

sam: ugh, okay. do we have an example payload?

edgehalo-int: here's a sanitized sample we received from their ops team: ```json
{
  "device_id": "EH-91A2",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T18:14:00Z",
  "units": 1,
  "granularity": "minute",
  "signature": "REDACTED"
}
```

nisha: thanks. our contract says partner must send hourly aggregates OR include a `window_id` for minute claims. If granularity==minute we should reject unless they opt into high-frequency ingestion.

alexa: can we detect duplicates by signature + window_id? current dedupe keys are (device_id, hour, partner_event_id). we'll need (device_id, window_start_iso) for minute.

sam: quick mitigation: treat incoming minute records as provisional and queue to a 'validation' path. if duplicates with later hourly rollup arrive, automatically expire provisional credits. ops-bot: create ticket for provisional-path?

ops-bot: created PARTNER-3452: "EdgeHalo minute-ingest provisional queue + backfill expiry" assigned to sam. Link: https://redwood.internal/partners/3452

maria: planning note — we should notify marketplace team because entitlement mapping (SKU rate-limits) is hourly. this can cause temporary overage alerts for customers. @alexa can you draft the partner notice?

alexa: sure. draft pushed to /docs/partners/edgehalo-minute-ingest.md. TL;DR: accept minute claims during onboarding only, require window_id, enable idempotency header X-Request-Sig.

nisha: for reconciliation/backfill: propose a nightly job that collapses minute rows to hourly and runs a checksum vs partner-provided hourly file. SQL-ish idea: ```sql
INSERT INTO partner_hourly_agg (device_id, hour, units)
SELECT device_id, date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS hour, sum(units)
FROM partner_minute_claims
WHERE processed = false
GROUP BY device_id, hour;
```
Mark processed=true after successful commit.

sam: add acceptance tests: ingest 90 random minute events that sum to an hourly payload, then submit both and ensure marketplace billing only counts once. write test harness under integration/partners/edgehalo/minute-to-hour.spec.ts

maria: timeline? EdgeHalo needs a fix this week. can we ship a detection + provisional queue by EOD Thu and the nightly collapse on Friday?

sam: yes, working with eng runtime for gating. dev hours estimate ~12. I'll pair with infra tomorrow.

alexa: partner comm goes out after we have detection in prod, probably Fri morning. include rollback instructions and opt-out flag.

edgehalo-int: thanks — we'll also patch our side to include `window_id` and set a header `X-Redwood-Ingest: minute` to make detection deterministic. ETA Friday morning from our side too.

nisha: follow-ups: 1) update dedupe key schema, 2) add unit tests for backfill, 3) confirm marketplace won't double-bill during migration window. I'll own bill-safety checks.

maria: perfect. I'll coordinate cross-team standup tomorrow 9:30 PT. tagging @sam @nisha @alexa. :calendar:

sam: adding tech notes to the ticket. anyone see risk we missed?

alexa: confirm timezone handling in date_trunc('hour', timestamp) — partner timestamps are UTC so safe. just call out explicitly in partner notice.

maria: ok that's everything for now, will update thread after standup. :wave:
